description: hexa runs Codex as an agent backend through a new inference adapter and configuration

specs.description: A provider named codex is served by a CodexInferenceAdapter built by adapter_for_endpoint
specs.given: an inference endpoint registered with provider name codex
specs.then: a CodexInferenceAdapter implementing IInferencePort is returned

specs.description: An unregistered or unknown provider name is never served by a CodexInferenceAdapter
specs.given: an inference endpoint registered with an unknown provider name unknown-provider
specs.then: it refuses to build a CodexInferenceAdapter and returns an unknown provider error

specs.description: Every complete call passes the hardcoded permission-bypass flag to the process spawner
specs.given: a CodexInferenceAdapter initialized with an injectable ProcessSpawner
specs.when: complete() is called on the adapter

specs.description: A complete call never omits the permission-bypass flag even if requested
specs.given: a CodexInferenceAdapter and a request attempting to suppress permission bypassing
specs.when: complete() is called on the adapter
specs.then: it refuses to execute without --dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox in the spawner arguments

specs.description: The reply is successfully extracted from the last message output file
specs.given: a codex execution that exits with zero and writes a last message to the designated temp file
specs.then: the adapter returns the file contents as the inference response text

specs.description: A non-zero exit or an empty output file is never treated as an empty success
specs.given: a codex execution that exits with a non-zero status or leaves the output file empty
specs.then: it refuses to return a success and returns an InferenceError instead

specs.description: A model other than the bare id codex passes the model flag
specs.when: complete() builds the codex command arguments

specs.description: The bare model id codex never passes a model flag
specs.given: an InferenceRequest specifying the bare model id codex
specs.when: complete() builds the codex command arguments
specs.then: it refuses to include the -m flag, relying on Codex's default model

specs.description: Codex-served models are treated as agents and refused by spec ledger commands
specs.given: a project configured with a model served by the codex provider
specs.when: hexa spec tests or hexa spec draft is executed
specs.then: it refuses the operation with the rule message naming ADR-2610221540 §2

specs.description: A Codex-served model is never permitted to act as the test writer
specs.given: a Codex-served model attempting to write or execute spec tests
specs.when: hexa spec tests checks the test author identity
specs.then: it refuses to allow the agent CLI to write the specification tests

specs.description: hexa inference add codex checks login status and writes an endpoint without key references
specs.given: an operator running hexa inference add codex while logged in
specs.then: it writes an endpoint with provider codex, no URL, and no key reference

specs.description: hexa inference add codex refuses when not logged in
specs.given: an operator running hexa inference add codex while not logged in
specs.then: it refuses to register the endpoint and reports the command to run for logging in
